nom: TONYMOLY Mask Melt Multi-Zone Forehead + Neck Mask

segments.mature: A 40-year-old reviewer reports the forehead patch left her skin looking smooth and plump and made a good base for makeup.

concerns.aging: Reviewers report smoother, firmer-looking skin and reduced appearance of fine lines after one use, with one comparing the effect to a tox-like smoothing on the forehead; results are described as visible the next morning but not permanent.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers describe the mask as hydrating, with skin feeling plump, soft, and less dry afterward, including less dryness specifically noted in the forehead area; one reviewer found it dried out fairly quickly and wished for more serum.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer noted temporary itchiness with no irritation; otherwise no barrier issues reported.

aspects.libelle: Slips or rolls off the neck
Stays in place well on forehead
Skin feels smooth and soft after use
Sizing too large for smaller foreheads
Dries out quickly, thin material can tear

extraits.titre: Forehead, maybe. Not good for necks.
extraits.texte: Dear God don't try to sleep with this on your neck, it won't stay in place. When The packaging says to keep your chin uplifted, they mean it. I have to have my head tilted all the way back in order to keep this from folding in on itself or rolling off. I cannot sleep like this. that also means that I cannot wear it standing up during the day walking around I can't wear it doing anything other than having my head tilted towards the ceiling just so this will stay in place on my neck. What a waste of money as a neck mask.

Complimentary from tonymoly. I wish I could tell you how this went, but it didn't even last 5 minutes. If you have nails, it's going to rip it. I had it on my neck and it kept moving, slipping and adjusting it made it worse, because after adjusting it many times, it ripped.

I gotta say, I much prefer these jelly type masks over the old school style. These stay in place perfectly & feel great on the skin! I applied this to my forehead & it felt so smooth afterwards. I'm did my makeup afterwards & my 40 y/o skin looked incredible! So smooth & plump! My only complaint, it this is a little large & I have a big head/forehead. lol It goes into my widows peak, so if you have a small forehead, these could get wild. lol I would definitely use these again tho! *Gifted by tonymoly

I didn't really expect to do much after one use, but I was very impressed. I used the patch on my forehead. I don't have a lot of wrinkles to begin, but after using this patch one night, my forehead was incredibly smooth the next morning and genuinely looked like I got tox injections (I've never had them btw). The result seemed to last throughout the day. The patch was easily to apply and remove, and it stayed in place all night. I will be purchasing more of these. [Gifted by TonyMoly]

I tried the Mask Melt Multi-Zone Forehead + Neck Mask, and it feels super soothing and hydrating. The forehead patch smooths fine lines while the neck mask leaves my skin soft and firm. I love that it stays in place and gives a spa-like feel at home. It's perfect for a self-care night, though I wish it came with a bit more serum. Gifted by tonymoly. it dries out a little fast.

complimentary from tonymoly. In the morning, my skin looked plumper and more refreshed. I noticed less dryness in my forehead area and my makeup went on smoother after using it. It's not a miracle overnight, but after a few uses I definitely saw my skin looking healthier and more hydrated. Recommend trying.

This is an interesting idea and new take on face masks. It was easy to apply and didn't slip and slide off! It felt very hydrating on my forehead and neck. My skin did feel itchy at one point but there was no irritation. Gifted by tonymoly

reserve: Most reviews are gifted/promotional, focus on fit and general hydration rather than diverse skin types or specific concerns like acne, redness, or oiliness, so segmentation beyond 'mature' and general hydration/aging claims is limited.
